incidents.title: Post-termination access detected
incidents.subject: synthetic.user07@example.invalid
incidents.summary: An identity recorded as terminated had subsequent successful access activity.
incidents.recommendation: Confirm HR effective time and approved exceptions; verify deprovisioning and session revocation with asset owners.
incidents.narrative: Observed pattern: An identity recorded as terminated had subsequent successful access activity. There are 3 supporting events from 3 source system(s). This alert establishes a correlation, not a confirmed root cause. Suggested next step: Confirm HR effective time and approved exceptions; verify deprovisioning and session revocation with asset owners.
